title: CA: required SliQ release packages
public_pr_body:
CA packages the required JNR SliQ 140/141 releases on current #247 head 41c685c416305637d86b580324fff9e6cda037ff. The cutover plan is explicitly 138, 140, 141, 144, 145, 146. Copy the held owner's implementation/verification bodies and pin every input with SHA-256; add verified-138 prerequisite for 140, verified-140 prerequisite for 141, exact preflight markers and a checksum/preflight checker whose unit tests fail if either marker is removed.

140 rollback retains its existing imported-reference refusal. The copied 141 rollback now additionally refuses any opening WIP rows; both rollback packages verify the reviewed object shape first. No data may be removed to force rollback. Source implementation branch claude/sliq-import at 3593615eb34c2dd66b152ca3eaca227bd8475f5f is unchanged. This is Rhys's explicitly assigned CA integration, not a takeover of that held job. Ownership/handover updates are in separate docs-only #271, so this code PR has no docs/ files.

Assumption: keep frozen numbered baseline/catalogue tests unchanged. The identity-guarded disposable SQL proof is sequenced after every baseline file and before the original 145/146 proofs, and prepares imports there. That test chronology already has baseline 144; it is not proof of the separate actual cutover order, which must be rehearsed independently. No existing assertion is removed; two fixture ordering/classification assumptions were expanded to preserve every old proof while adding the new one.

Validation: full unit suite 5,457 passed, 0 failed/skipped; 19 focused release/ordering checks passed; TypeScript, changed-file lint, checksum and diff checks passed. New real two-company role/write/link/source-ref SQL proof is defined but NOT TESTED yet. The local empty backend's default ECR image pull was forbidden; the pinned official CLI's supported GHCR mirror reached the image store but failed with no space left on device before any database started; no real SQL proof ran. No SQL applied to real data. No Ready label, merge, main push, deployment or secrets. This is not release/SQL/go-live approval and does not claim reviewer SAFE.

- [x] CA: reviewable pinned release package and company-isolation proof added.
- [ ] Next: real disposable ordered install/verify/rollback/isolation evidence, exact CI results and independent reviewer decision.
